questions.qtext: Which of the following statements is/are true in the construction of a Bipolar junction transistor?

options.text: The collector region dissipates more power.
The collector is made physically larger than emitter.
The emitter and collector can be interchanged.

questions.solution:
(a, c)
• The collector region is made physically larger than the emitter region because it has to dissipate much greater power.
• The emitter injects majority carriers into the base region.
• The emitter and collector regions have different doping concentrations and thicknesses, cannot be interchanged.
Hence, only options (a) and (c) are correct.
